title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: two namespaces' stored permission sets of one name are each kept and served at their own package
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_

Fixes #32780

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — widened: a save, publish or restore of a permission set whose name a package of another namespace stores moves from `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` to saved, and each package serves its own stored set; narrowed: after a restart, a grant naming no package of a name two packages hold (one ships it, one of another namespace stores it) moves from conferring a set to conferring nothing, as the running kernel already answered before the restart (ADR-0150 D3).
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` already teaches naming `permission_set_package` on a grant when two packages hold the name; the moved answer is that case, and no skill teaches the save door's refusal text.

> **BREAKING** for a grant that names no package while two packages hold the set's name: a grant naming no package confers nothing when two packages hold the name, after a restart as before it. Name the package on the grant (`permission_set_package`) to confer that package's set. A name one package holds confers as before.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:权限集按「包 + 名称」各自存放;不同命名空间的两个包可以各自保存同名权限集,各自在自己的包下生效;同命名空间、平台命名空间等原有拒绝不变,拒绝提示改为写入方自己能做的步骤。
- 为什么改:原来同名的已存权限集只能占一个全局位置,第二个包的保存被误拒,重启后的答案也与运行中的内核不一致,与 ADR-0150 D2 的「包 + 名称」规则不符。
- 风险与回滚:风险在重启后的授权解析;一条不指定包的授权在两个包同时持有该名称时不再授予任何权限(重启前本来就如此)。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-registry-hydration.ts`(已存行进入所属包的位置、不借用他包信封),`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`(保存门判据与提示),`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`(冷启动检查仍把声明包自身的已存行算作环境持有)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading.test.ts`,预期全部通过,其中 `[#32780]` 一组覆盖两种保存顺序、重启、删除与锁。
- 需要你做的:评审这条收窄声明(授权不指定包时的重启后答案)。

## What changes

A permission set is `(package, name)` (ADR-0150 D2).

- **`metadata-protocol` boot hydration and save write-through** (`protocol-registry-hydration.ts`): a stored permission row bound to a package now takes that package's own registry slot, as the other package-slotted types already do (#33127). `flow` stays where it was. The stored set stays its own package's tenant-authored set, so the packaged-permission-set lock reads only a shipped set as packaged.
- **`metadata-protocol` save door** (`protocol-save-door-refusals.ts`): two holders of a name are judged by the one namespace predicate (`permissionSetHoldersMeet`) alone. A stored holder no longer counts as conflicting whatever its namespace. The refusal that stays names steps the writer can take (rename its own set, or delete a set the environment or another package stores), never an edit inside another package. Envelope unchanged.
- **`objectql` cold-boot check** (`registry.ts`, ADR-0048 N.3, kept): a stored set bound to the package that declares the name is the environment's at the cold boot also where it now sits in that package's own slot. The boot refuses as before, naming that package alone. A row in another package's slot does not count.

## FROM → TO

| Case (packages `crm`, `hr`, `fin` of three namespaces) | FROM (main) | TO (this PR) |
|---|---|---|
| `hr` saves, publishes or restores a set of a name `crm` stores | `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` naming `crm` | saved; each package's grant confers its own set |
| `crm` saves its own set beside `hr`'s stored one; `fin` saves one too | `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` naming `hr` | saved; each served at its own package |
| restart over two packages' stored sets of one name, in either row order and install order | not reached (the second save was refused) | each package's grant confers its own set; neither reads as shipped |
| after a restart, a grant naming no package, where `crm` ships the name and `hr` stores it | confers a set | **confers nothing** (two holders, ADR-0150 D3), as the running kernel answered before the restart |
| delete of one package's stored set | retires the name's bare entry | retires that package's slot alone; the other set stays served, also after a restart |
| second package of the SAME namespace, a platform namespace, a package with no namespace, the environment | `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT`, remedy "rename it in package …" | `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` (unchanged), remedy names the writer's own rename or a deletable stored set |
| cold boot over a stored set bound to the package that declares the name (ADR-0048 N.3) | boot refused `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` | boot refused `422 NAMESPACE_CONFLICT` (unchanged) |
| package-less stored permission row | bare entry | bare entry (unchanged) |

## Tests

New and moved pins (all at head `5fb04355de`):

- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-permission-set-name-registry-reading.test.ts`, describe `[#32780] two namespaces' stored permission sets of one name: each served at its own package`. Both save orders: both sets land, each package's grant confers its own set, a grant naming no package confers nothing, and neither set reads as shipped. All of that holds after a restart in either row order and either install order. A delete of either set retires that package's slot alone, also after a restart. `crm` declares a set, then `hr` saves, `crm` saves its own and `fin` saves: each lands and each is served at its own package. A set `hr` stores before `crm` ships the name: after a restart, each package's grant confers its own package's set. CONTROLs: a second package of the same namespace is still refused, and the remedy names the writer's steps. An install-declared name of the same namespace is still refused, and the remedy offers the writer's own rename only. ADR-0048 N.3: a stored set bound to the declaring package refuses the restart, naming that package alone. The earlier pin `crm + hr where crm STORES its set` is flipped to admitted.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/packaged-permission-set-lock.test.ts`: a stored permission set in its package's registry slot is never read as shipped, over a real registry and the protocol's boot hydration.
- `packages/objectql/src/webhook-stored-row-boot-hydration.test.ts`: the permission CONTROL now reads a stray package's row as its own package's set, in its own slot, while each holder keeps its shipped set.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-registry-heal-packageless-refusal.test.ts`: `permission` moves from the bare-slot group to the CONTROL group, because its bound row takes its package's own slot.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-boot-hydration-scoped.test.ts:432` (ADR-0048 N.3) is unchanged and green.

<details><summary>Dogfood battery at 5fb04355de</summary>

`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the verify lock, no shard, after the closure build above. VERDICT command-exit 0, held 1882s. Test Files 469 passed, 3 skipped (472) · Tests 3974 passed, 42 skipped (4016). No failures.

<details><summary>Ablation (each leg red, then restored; blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty after each)</summary>

Each leg goes through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. The `metadata-protocol` legs rebuild the package and prove the marker is in `dist/` with `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`. After a restore build, `--absent` proves every marker is gone.

- L1, put back the stored-holder refusal at the save door: 8 failed of 91 (objectql pins). That includes the declared-set save sequence and every both-orders and delete pin.
- L2, leave `permission` out of package slotting: 5 failed objectql, 2 failed plugin-security (at `04bd217aa4`).
- L3, remove the own-package guard the boot hydration applies to a stored permission row: 3 failed objectql (the webhook stray-row pin in both orders, and the shipped-after-stored restart pin), 1 failed plugin-security.
- L4, the old remedy text: 2 failed (the two CONTROLs, at `04bd217aa4`).
- L5, the namespace predicate never meets: 10 failed. These are every same-namespace, platform and no-namespace refusal, and both CONTROLs.
- L6, do not state tenant authorship on a stored permission row: 3 failed objectql, 3 failed plugin-security.
- L7, the cold boot ignores a self-bound row in its package's own slot (`objectql` source, read by the suite directly): 2 failed. These are the ADR-0048 N.3 pin at `protocol-boot-hydration-scoped.test.ts:432` and the N.3 CONTROL.

The first attempt of L1, L3, L5 and L6 did nothing. Their string-literal markers were constant-folded out of `dist/`, and the preflight refused before any test ran. A second L3/L5 attempt did not build (an unused variable). All of them were redone with markers the build keeps, and the readings above are from those runs.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `objectql/src/registry.ts` is edited per the seat's ruling on the cold-boot question (keep ADR-0048 N.3). The change is one reader in the private cold-boot check, and no public member changes.
- Outside this PR: the managed-package seal at the save door and the packaged-permission-set lock gate both judge by name alone. So a package's save of its own set under a name another namespace's package ships in code is refused before the namespace rule is read. The pins reach the "beside a shipped set" case through an install-declared claim, and through a set stored before the other package shipped the name. This is reported to the seat, not fixed here.

- `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`: "1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition" (`[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).
- `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs`: OK. `pnpm check:engine-double-contract`: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --tier`: no path-derived mandate, 470 changed lines, under the 3000 human-merge threshold. The declaration shape matches the #33646 precedent (`Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` with a widened and a narrowed half, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `!` title).
- Overlap: `git merge-tree --write-tree` of this head against `origin/main` (`dfb8ed3570`), PR #33979's head (`999b09d9c3`) and PR #34092's head (`d2aa1132d3`) all exit 0.
